name: revamp-vacations
description: Read-only access to Revamp Vacations' published Armenia travel listings: search, details, availability and quotes, and trip plans.

interface.longDescription:
Revamp Vacations is a curated travel marketplace for Armenia. This app gives ChatGPT read-only access to Revamp's published listings: guesthouses, apartments and hotels; guided tours; hands-on experiences; restaurants; and places to visit.

You can search by place, type or interest; read a listing's full details; see only what's available for your dates and group size, including time slots with seats left for tours and experiences; see the full price breakdown with fees, tax, cancellation terms and how payment works; and get a day-by-day itinerary built from real listings.

The app never books, pays or changes anything. Each result links to the listing on revampvacations.com, where you can book. No account is needed.
